policy.personal_recruit_conservation: personal recruits enter the conserved personal-force cohort ledger; individual materialization consumes one existing cohort body and never changes force headcount
policy.standout_materialization_policy: personal and institutional soldiers remain aggregate until named, exceptional, command-relevant, specialist, socially relevant, or otherwise causally important; materialization never duplicates headcount
policy.command_establishment_rule: army/unit commander and deputy are outside fighting-strength troop numbers; 1,000/500 internal commanders are conserved fighting bodies.
